acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:569d8f97-.title: GRC Pre-Sales Consultant / Solutions Engineer – DACH market, EMEA
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:569d8f97-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role. You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success. With this role being specific to support our DACH Market account teams and customers, having full German Language proficiency is a must for this successful candidate. This role will be based from our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on. What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: - Own the technical relationship with our commercial prospects/customers - Develop a deep understanding of our product capabilities, integrations, configurations messaging, partner ecosystem, and competitive landscape. - Listen carefully to prospects and clients to provide market feedback to the product team and help prioritise functionality needed to drive sales opportunities - Support customers thought their trial process with Vanta - Build product examples, documentation, and other critical resources for our customers - Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement - Creatively identify and help drive new programs to improve the pre to post-sales transition How to be successful in this role: - Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) - Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer or equivalent title - Have previous B2B SaaS experience - Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture - Have strong project management skills with a proven ability to operate in a startup environment that lacks structure of a larger organisation - Be creative, technical, and naturally persuasive - Be detail-oriented and organised. - Love listening to customers, discussing strategy with colleagues, but also diving into the weeds. - Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills - Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus - Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity space What you can expect as a Vanta'n in the UK: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office - Pension matching - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time - 8 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:98.title: Heavy Duty Diesel Shop Manager
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:98.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Heavy-Duty Diesel Shop Manager to lead operations at a satellite repair facility specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance. This role requires a hands-on leader with the ability to diagnose required repairs and assist technicians in completing service orders while ensuring efficient shop operations. The facility consists of a two-bay shop that operates with a team of two technicians and a manager when fully staffed. The shop primarily services front-loaded cement mixers and tri-axle dump trucks, while also handling a wide range of heavy-duty repair work across the commercial truck industry.
responsibilities: Manage day-to-day operations of the satellite shop location and maintain a fully staffed team of two active technicians.
Provide hands-on leadership by diagnosing repair needs and assisting technicians with the completion of service orders when necessary.
Coordinate the daily shop schedule and workflow to ensure efficient service operations.
Monitor technician productivity and shop performance to meet company benchmarks for labor hours and billed service time.
Maintain quality control standards and ensure all work meets company and industry expectations.
Utilize OEM diagnostic platforms and industry-standard tools, including Cummins and PACCAR diagnostic systems, as well as Snap-on, JPRO, and other required diagnostic equipment.
Manage shop inventory levels and maintain organization of tools and equipment.
Order special-order parts as required to complete service orders and maintain workflow.
Communicate regularly with company leadership regarding shop performance, operational updates, and improvement opportunities.
qualifications: Valid Class A driver’s license (Preferred)
Previous experience in heavy-duty diesel repair, with the ability to diagnose and assist with complex mechanical and electrical issues.
Prior leadership or shop management experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of heavy-duty truck diagnostics, including experience with OEM diagnostic software such as Cummins and PACCAR systems.
Familiarity with industry diagnostic platforms such as Snap-on, JPRO, or equivalent tools.
Ability to manage workflow, technicians, and shop productivity in a fast-paced service environment.
Strong organizational and communication skills.
Valid driver’s license required.
Ability to consistently arrive on time and maintain a reliable work schedule.
Willingness to work a standard schedule of approximately 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM, with flexibility as operational needs require.
Must be able to pass random and incident-based drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policies.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:25cd5e51-19aa-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager (Internal HRIS / HR Tech) based in Switzerland. This is a product leadership opportunity focused on building and evolving internal HR technology for a global, distributed organization. You will own product discovery, requirements, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across core HRIS capabilities, including Core HR and Time Off. Working closely with Design, AI-assisted Development, and business stakeholders, you will turn complex needs into clear, actionable product requirements. You will play a central role in improving B2B and administrative user experiences while ensuring secure, scalable, and intuitive workflows. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from discovery and design through testing, launch, and user adoption. It is well suited to an independent Product Manager who thrives in fast-paced, highly collaborative, and AI-enabled product environments. Own product discovery, requirements gathering, prioritization, and roadmap development for internal HR technology products. Conduct stakeholder interviews and translate business and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable solutions. Audit existing products and workflows to determine what should be retained, redesigned, or removed. Create and maintain high-quality PRDs, user stories, user flows, acceptance criteria, and detailed product specifications. Own the delivery of core HRIS modules, including Core HR and Time Off. Partner closely with Design and AI-assisted Development teams to maintain a continuous pipeline of ready-to-build requirements. Review Figma designs and ensure proposed solutions align with product requirements and B2B/admin UX standards. Manage the product backlog, priorities, dependencies, and sprint planning using Jira, Linear, or similar tools. Lead User Acceptance Testing, feature validation, and product sign-offs to ensure solutions meet business and user expectations. Coordinate launch readiness activities, including SSO, Slack integrations, data migration, and RBAC/security testing. Drive products through discovery, development, production go-live, and user adoption. Gather ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders and continuously iterate based on evolving business and product needs. Keep engineering teams unblocked by providing clear requirements, timely decisions, and effective prioritization. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, ideally within B2B SaaS, HR Tech, enterprise software, or other complex digital products. Strong experience creating PRDs, user stories, user flows, acceptance criteria, and product specifications. Strong product sense with experience designing or reviewing B2B and administrative interfaces. Good understanding of complex workflows, data-dense tables, permissions, bulk actions, and role-based user experiences. Hands-on experience with Figma and the ability to effectively participate in product and design reviews. Experience working in Agile product development environments using Jira, Linear, or comparable tools. Practical experience conducting UAT, feature testing, validation, and product sign-offs. Strong systems-thinking skills and a working understanding of RBAC, permissions, and administrative data structures. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently and confidently across multiple teams. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where AI-assisted development is part of the product delivery process. Ability to maintain momentum, resolve ambiguity, and ensure engineering teams have the information required to deliver effectively. Experience with HRIS, ATS, HR Tech, or internal enterprise tools is a strong advantage. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a5600718-52a3-4d30.title: Operations Manager
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a5600718-52a3-4d30.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Operations Manager до нашої команди у Варшаві Які виклики чекають: - підтримувати операційну частину бізнесових задач - аналізувати ключові метрики та warning сигнали та надавати рекомендації - оптимізувати процеси у крос-командних політиках і флоу - автоматизувати мануальні та рутинні процеси - активна взаємодія із крос-функціональними командами - фінанси, legal, product, аналітика Що для нас важливо: - Досвід роботи 1+ рік в FMCG/ консалтингу/ фінансах/ operations- менеджменті на позиції аудитора, консультанта, аналітика тощо - Упевнене знання Excel/Google Spreadsheet - Вміння аналізувати великі обсяги інформації - Увага до деталей - Володіння англійською мовою на рівні B2 - Відмінні комунікативні навички та здатність чітко формулювати свої думки - Здатність працювати в динамічному середовищі та адаптуватися до змін Буде плюсом: - Досвід роботи із Tableau У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. - Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів. Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!
